source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The patch removes two unused legacy histogram paths and their dedicated message counter. The accepted indexer still calculates time per token from _perfIndexStopwatch and uses it to adjust _indexTokens. The datastore still creates or opens global-messages-db.sqlite. Keep those behavioral consumers separate from the removed reporting code. The discussion chose removal instead of a Glean migration and required coordinated platform landing; no telemetry usage survey or benchmark ran here.
title: Gloda telemetry removal keeps adaptive indexing timing
